nouvel-ai-shutian-call.summary: Exploratory recruitment conversation about a potential customer-facing technical role at Nouvel AI. The candidate expressed interest in applied AI work and discussed their mathematics, diffusion-model research and healthcare project experience. Both parties agreed to reconnect, provisionally on Monday, while the candidate explores agent tools. No role, compensation package or exact meeting time was agreed.
nouvel-ai-shutian-call.notes:
Conversation type: exploratory recruitment, not a customer sales opportunity.
Company focus: automating sales and onboarding administration using agents, including transcript-based follow-ups, contract reminders, payment collection and Slack updates. The representative described current work as applied rather than research-focused.
Potential role: customer-facing solutions engineering or forward-deployed engineering, understanding client requirements and tailoring platform capabilities and dashboards. A purely engineering role was not presented as the current priority.
Candidate background: studied mathematics, worked on diffusion models from a research perspective, and is building a healthcare/insurance integration project intended to be shown to London company Penelope. Employment by Penelope was not established.
Interest and constraints: interested in practical technical work and developing commercial experience. Based in London and concerned about routinely working very late to support San Francisco clients. Remote work and flexible hours were discussed, but no schedule was agreed.
Compensation: candidate estimated needing around 2,000 per month, or 24,000–25,000 annually, to cover rent and living costs. Currency and gross/net basis were not explicitly confirmed. Equity was raised as negotiable; no offer was made.
Next steps: representative will consider the potential fit against company needs. Candidate agreed to explore the agent tools discussed. A further phone conversation was provisionally discussed for Monday; the exact date, time and time zone remain unclear due to transcription quality.
